new_defect_types.name: slogan_filler_text
new_defect_types.description: Unrequested, correctly-spelled motivational/marketing slogans stamped on many surfaces (posters, erasers, laptops, concrete, pods). Template set-dressing made of text.
examples: phi378/gpt_image_2p5_sunburst_quality_high: slogans on 8 surfaces incl. eraser 'Keep Going', robot 'Better Learners Brighter Tomorrows'
phi134/gpt_image_2p5_sunburst: 'BUILD SAFER SMARTER TOGETHER' on banner, 'PROGRESS BUILDS TOMORROW' on concrete
orig375/gpt_image_2p5_sunburst_quality_high: 'LIFE PRESERVATION FOR A BRIGHTER TOMORROW' etched on cryo-pod
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: A02/A03 only fire on misspellings; B04 covers prompt words leaking; B07 lists objects (brick walls, plants) not text. Correct but unrequested text has no home.

new_defect_types.name: semantic_text_error
new_defect_types.description: Text spelled correctly but factually/semantically impossible: wrong station names, impossible dates, wrong place combos.
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: A02 checks letters, not meaning; no rule on well-formed-but-wrong text.

new_defect_types.name: wrong_tool_form / functional object misrender
new_defect_types.description: A specific functional instrument replaced by a lookalike that cannot do the job (laryngoscope -> pen/rod/dental probe/syringe, LiDAR -> camera, hose plugged into laryngoscope).
examples: phi10/flux3_klein_base: long curved probe instead of laryngoscope
phi10/krea2_turbo: breathing hose attached to laryngoscope handle
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: Split between A10 and B02 with no guidance for 'nearly the right tool'; judges disagree on which code.

new_defect_types.name: temporal_moment_mismatch
new_defect_types.description: Prompt specifies a moment (before impact, mid-swing) and the image shows a different moment (impact under way, debris burst).
examples: phi495/ideogram4_nf4: ball hitting wall with debris
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: B03 is about action/pose; 'timing of an event' is not mentioned, so judges skip it.

new_defect_types.name: prompt_word_literalism
new_defect_types.description: A figurative word is rendered literally (cactus 'branch' as arm -> real woody tree branch with leaves).
examples: orig495/qwen_image_2p1_pe: cactus arm becomes leafy tree branch
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: Shows up as A08 fusion but the cause is semantic; a B-level check 'figurative language rendered literally' would catch it more reliably.

rubric_issues.problem: Concept-art prompts legitimately yield character sheets with inset panels; A16 says 'split panel' is a defect.
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Split panels/insets are intended when the requested medium is concept art, character sheet, storyboard, comic, or reference sheet.

rubric_issues.problem: 'To her left ... to her right' with a camera-facing subject: all 12 models used viewer-left; strictly that is mirrored. Rubric does not say which frame to use.
examples: orig375: all 12 models put pod at viewer-left
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: When left/right is relative to a character facing the camera, accept either frame (or explicitly default to viewer frame) and do not flag; only flag when both objects are on the same side.

rubric_issues.problem: Requested timecode/overlay text (CCTV) has no quoted string; is it A02 or B04? Malformed timecode should be A02 major since it is the requested text.
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Requested-but-unquoted text (timecode, date, label) is A02 intended text; judge its format plausibility (valid date/time) rather than exact string.

rubric_issues.problem: CCTV prompts ask for compression artifacts and motion blur; nearly every model outputs a clean photo. B05 mentions grain/blur but not compression/CCTV looks, and A21-A23 might penalise them if present.
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: List compression artifacts, low-res CCTV, scanlines in B05 looks; state that requested degradation is excluded from A21/A23.

rubric_issues.problem: Notebooks full of pseudo-math are everywhere; unclear whether a notebook a prompt mentions ('math notes') is intended text (A02) or incidental (A03).
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Text whose content the prompt names (math notes, a menu) is A02; grade it as content-correct vs pseudo-glyph.

false_positive_traps.description: Vertical wrecking-ball cable during 'mid-swing' is physically correct (bottom of arc); do not flag as not swinging.
Tape over patient eyes, face shields, eye protection during intubation are real clinical practice, not anomalies.
Motion blur on a LiDAR head expresses 'spinning' and is requested, not A21.
Upside-down face (camera at patient's feet looking at the chin) reads as melted/odd anatomy at a glance but is correct foreshortening.
Gown displayed on headless dress form - reads as missing head but is a mannequin; only a B question.
Blurred potted plant outside the window looks like a ghost/duplicate reflection but is just a balcony object behind glass.
